thought.text: Register dengan email tersedia. Saya isi dan lihat langkah berikutnya.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 260 python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -28
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import time
em=f"kg{int(time.time())}@sinaja.cyou"; print("email:",em)
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=False,args=["--no-sandbox"])
    pg=b.new_page(viewport={"width":1366,"height":900})
    pg.goto("https://www.kaggle.com/account/login?phase=startRegisterTab",wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=90000)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(5000)
    pg.fill('input[name="email"]',em)
    pg.click("text=Register with Email")
    pg.wait_for_timeout(7000)
    print("URL:",pg.url)
    print("BODY:",pg.inner_text("body")[:700].replace("\n"," | "))
    for inp in pg.locator("input").all():
        t=inp.get_attribute("type")
        if t!="hidden": print("input:",inp.get_attribute("name"),"|",t)
    b.close()
PY
